label: late original phase / <DEL> in sequences starting a/n with u at position 2 (weak)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.02% of steps). It fires only in the late original phase (orig_idx 4-8, rate rising toward the end) and on the <DEL> step (24% of mass), and never in the copy phase or at t<4. It favours long sequences (L=8-9) and first-occurrence inputs. Which sequences it fires on depends heavily on the prefix: first token a or n (lift ~10x, 66% of mass), with u at position 2 and m somewhere in the prefix showing up often. But no conjunction of prefix tokens tested gets precision above ~0.2 or F1 above ~0.13. It looks like a fine-grained detector of a combination of stored hidden-state contents that these variables do not capture. Magnitude is roughly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.25). The highest activations come from sequences with first token a/n and u at position 2, but this was not checked systematically.
